limitations: One humanitarian Education plan cluster, not all education funding or independently measured need.
Reported funding is not asserted to be cash paid, final spending or money reaching people.
Price/FX basis, reporting completeness and transaction-status decomposition are unknown.
Source-rounded percent and exact-rational derived coverage are different values.
No other plan, country, cluster, financial framework or year is pooled; shared/unspecified funding is not allocated.
Cause mapping is draft; no independent reviewer, rating, outcome or funding-by-depth allocation is supplied.
This pure projection has no client retrieval clock, source-origin proof or admitted Observation edition.
